target_profile.scope: Native Apple-silicon macOS binaries, including required public and Apple-specific extensions and ABI behavior; host extensions selected by explicit capability checks.
target_profile.inventory_limits: Reviewed shared A64 forms only. This list is not a complete Apple CPU feature contract, private-extension inventory, or binary-compatibility denominator.

instruction_sources.redistribution_scope: Only factual identifiers, names, categorical/feature metadata and fixed encoding bits are included. Arm XML, authored instruction prose and pseudocode remain local and are not redistributed.

profile.description: Implemented means complete reviewed encoding-form semantics in the bounded ARM64 leaf profile. Ordinary transfers retain private-RAM scope; the explicitly scoped atomic/ordered cohorts use coherent shared Normal-WB RAM. Register-only MTE arithmetic uses its declared fixed ATA0/TCF0/GCR controls. Partial means operands, control flow or required semantics remain restricted. Aliases have no separate entries.
outside_scope: full guest exception delivery and asynchronous state reconstruction
tagged-address dereference, allocation-tag RAM and pointer-authentication key integration
complete ARM memory-model and production concurrent-runtime semantics
full application ABI and macOS boot

status_policy: Statuses apply only to explicitly reviewed forms in the declared bounded profile. Unreviewed required Apple forms have unknown count and are not claimed supported. Neither reviewed-form ratios nor corpus frequency represent whole-binary or OS completion. Aliases are not separate support units.

forms.label: 64-bit
forms.name: LDP (SIMD&FP)
forms.review: Exact June 2026 canonical encoding and operands reviewed. Current original ARM, independent byte math and native x86 full-state/RAM comparisons pass. Pair fault-policy checks retain 16 Unicorn second-load state differences explicitly; they are not hardware-conformance or full-state-agreement evidence. Fresh constrained-memory native/original-input evidence retains permitted outcome differences without normalization; normal transfer evidence remains unchanged.
forms.scope: Enabled FP/AdvSIMD and private ordinary little-endian RAM. S/D/Q signed7 scaled offset/pre/post addressing; independent vector and X/SP banks, V31 ordinary, scalar loads clear upper vector bits. STP duplicate sources are valid. Both pair loads stage before either guest destination changes; two stores expose first completed element if second faults, and basewriteback follows both. No concurrent128/256-bit atomicity, Qelementcrosspagefaultrollback, guestexceptiondelivery, MMIO, SVE/SME or tagged/PAC address claim. Fault-state preservation is an explicit staged native private-RAM policy:16 second-element load faults show a retained first-vector-only difference from Unicorn2.1.4. They are not full-state oracle equality or Apple-hardware validation; guest architectural exception delivery remains unsupported. LDPOVERLAP selects the source-permitted NOP outcome before operation-level access and writeback, under FP-present, unguarded-page/BTYPE=0 controls; common decode checks remain required outside this fixed profile.

Independent PCLMULQDQ targeting replaces the bounded SSE2 polynomial64 loop where available. Final native binaries, source maps and bounded representative instruction-path counts are retained; application performance remains separate.

forms.scope: Enabled FP/AdvSIMD/PMULL. PMUL byte lanes and PMULL byte/64-bit carryless full products; all allocated scalar/vector/by-element SQDMULH/SQRDMULH/SQDMULL/SQDMLAL/SQDMLSL shapes. All eight canonical scalar CRC32/CRC32C forms reviewed against the pinned Arm 2026-06 XML and Intel SDM CRC32. Independent reflected-polynomial long division, original ARM and native full-state comparisons cover baseline tables and checked SSE4.2 Castagnoli, register roles/aliases, all incoming NZCV, dirty upper bits, every input/accumulator bit and all byte-table entries. Original RET/native block dispatch and reserved width/size declines are checked. Actual emitted code/data ranges and candidate performance are recorded by the consolidated harness.
forms.scope: Uncomplemented IEEE/Castagnoli remainder over low 8/16/32/64-bit data and W accumulator, zero-extended W destination. Every register-31 role is ZR; sources are read before destination writes. Guest GPR/SP/NZCV/reserved/V/FP preservation and no guest memory access. Baseline table requires readable native code; checked x86 CRC32 is Castagnoli only. FEAT_CRC32 guest profile assumed; full PSTATE/DIT, feature-disabled guest exception delivery, application/OS compatibility and PCLMUL reduction remain outside scope.
